source: https://livebench.ai/ (leaderboard data files served by the site)
site_build: v=1791404103 (the cache-busting parameter the site appends; 2026-10-07)
note: 2026-06-25 names the LiveBench question set; models are scored and added to it after that date, which is why models released later (e.g. deepseek-v4.1-flash-max) appear. Category scores are the mean of the category's task scores (categories_2026_06_25.json) and the overall score the mean of the category scores, as the site computes them. The author's copy of the page sorted by Agentic Coding (https://livebench.ai/#/?sort=Agentic+Coding&dir=desc) matched these files on every value shown, up to one rounding difference.
what_it_measures: third-party evaluations of each model as served by its provider, with the reasoning effort named in the model id (deepseek-v4.1-flash-max: maximum effort, thinking on); NOT the 3-bit EXL3 stack measured in this paper
